title: Site comparison preserves the clopen projection and outgoing compositors
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $k:V\hookrightarrow W$ and $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ be quasi-compact open immersions, let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper, and suppose $pk=ir$. Put $P=W\times_T S$, $b:P\to W$, $q:P\to S$, and let $s:V\to P$ be the clopen lift [lem-cbc-etale-clopen-mate-normalization]. On each site let $\tau$ be the tail of the specified alpha [def-cbc-etale-clopen-mate-normalization-data, def-cbc-proetale-clopen-mate-data]: $J_bG_q\to J_bJ_sG_sG_q\to J_kG_r$, comprising the identity/zero clopen projection and the canonical open and inverse-image compositors with equality transports $bs=k$ and $qs=r$. For the canonical site comparisons $o$ and $a$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison, lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] and every etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $S$, $J_k^p(a_{r,F})\circ o_{k,G_r^eF}\circ A_W(\tau^e_F)=\tau^p_{A_SF}\circ J_b^p(a_{q,F})\circ o_{b,G_q^eF}$. The source of this square is $A_WJ_b^eG_q^e$; this assertion contains neither cartesian base change nor derived localization.

proof.text: The canonical comparison of extension by zero is the mate of comparison of inverse images for the open-extension adjunctions. Prove this by transporting the restriction adjunctions along upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction, and conjugating the identity-on-sections restriction square. This uses only the canonical comparisons of Tag 09AF.

For a clopen immersion, restriction of each identity/zero projection equals the unit of extension by zero followed by restriction. This follows by composing with the invertible support inclusion into direct image and the inverse-image/direct-image counit, using the two triangle identities. Two maps into extension by zero agree whenever their restrictions agree: identify the target with direct image and apply the inverse-image/direct-image Hom bijection. Apply this injectivity, the unit equation for the mate square from step 1, and naturality to identify the etale and proetale clopen projections. No choice of a complementary open, including any nonemptiness assumption, is needed.

Invert the given composition-coherence equations for extension by zero and inverse image by cancellation of their specified isomorphisms. Transport them along s;b=k and s;q=r by equality elimination. These are the two outgoing compositor squares needed in the tail.

A generic natural-transformation pasting lemma combines the projection square and the two compositor squares: move the outgoing open comparison past the inverse-image compositor, move the incoming open comparison past the projection, substitute the two compositor equations, and use naturality of the proetale open compositor and projection. Specialize to the clopen lift s and evaluate at F; the resulting equality is exactly the stated finiteClopenProEtaleTail formula.

theorem finiteClopenTailSiteTransport
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (i : S ⟶ T) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i)
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    let s := pullback.lift k r h
    letI := (Etale.ClopenMateNormalization.lift_clopen k r p i h).1
    letI := (Etale.ClopenMateNormalization.lift_clopen k r p i h).2
    let q := pullback.snd p i
    let b := pullback.fst p i
    (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) W).map
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b).map
            ((Etale.ClopenMateNormalization.projection Λ s).app
              ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q).obj F)) ≫
          ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) s b).inv ≫
            (Etale.ClopenMateNormalization.openCongr Λ (pullback.lift_fst k r h)).hom).app
              ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) s).obj
                ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q).obj F)) ≫
          (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).map
            (((Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) s q).inv ≫
              (eqToIso (congrArg (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
                (pullback.lift_snd k r h))).hom).app F)) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).hom.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).obj F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).map
        ((comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).inv.app F) =
    (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
        (pullback.fst p i)).hom.app
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.snd p i)).obj F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst p i)).map
        ((comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.snd p i)).inv.app F) ≫
      (finiteClopenProEtaleTail Λ k i r p h).app
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) S).obj F)
